DeployBot: preflight-eval report for candidate v2.4.0 -> BLOCKING: route="summarizer". metrics: ROUGE-L delta -6.8%, hallucination rate +4.9% (sample=1,000, p<0.01). Promotion paused. https://ci.redwood/evals/3951234567 :eyes:
Alex R: ack, pausing the release. can we get a short triage and a recommendation? :raised_hand:
Maria C: initial thought — prefer pin the summarizer route to last known-good (v2.3.8) rather than full rollback. minimizes customer impact.
Samir: what's the failure distribution? is it one prompt family or broad?
QA Bot: uploaded failing examples and quick buckets to the thread: top buckets = [overcompression, hallucinated-facts, churny-refs]. sample breakdown attached.
DeployBot: sample details: n=1000, fails=78, top 3 failing prompts shown at https://ci.redwood/evals/3951234567/failures
Jin K: if it's overcompression spiking, could be quant/decay or tokenizer tweak. do we have a bisect candidate?
Maria C: run a bisect across recent model commits first. if bisect narrows to model change, pin route. if bisect inconclusive but diff shows tokenization/serializer tweak, consider hotfix.
Samir: running quick bisect now: `rwctl bisect --suite prompt-suite/summarizer --from v2.3.8 --to v2.4.0 --samples 200`
Samir: bisect result (quick run): regression introduced between v2.3.9 -> v2.4.0. suspect quant profile change in 2.4.0 build step.
Alex R: ok. Maria, agree with pin then triage quieter window for a hotfix. we have a change window in 3h; prefer no noisy rollforward.
Maria C: I'll open ticket and document rollback criteria. Ticket: INF-4921. Keep release train moving for other routes.
Jin K: pin command ready: ``rwctl route-pin --route summarizer --model v2.3.8 --reason "preflight regression v2.4.0"``
Jin K: executing pin now...
DeployBot: ACTION: route summarizer pinned to v2.3.8 by Jin K at 3951234579. Confirmation: route state = pinned. Promotion for v2.4.0 blocked until triage + signoff.
Maria C: created INF-4921, assigned to @Samir and @Jin K with steps to reproduce + failing examples. leaving note for release manager to skip summarizer route in the next canary wave.
Samir: starting deeper bisect + rebuild of quant profile on a local runner. will post logs.
QA Bot: quick post-triage sanity: pin observed -> latency stable, error rate unchanged, customers unaffected so far.
Alex R: thanks everyone. decision: PIN summarizer route (v2.3.8) + triage for hotfix. if bisect points to non-model infra (tokenizer/compile) we may do a targeted rebuild and canary it behind the pin. :thumbsup:
Maria C: I'll send a short release note update and tag PMs + support.
Jin K: leaving small followup: when bisect finishes, please grep for any changed tokenization tests `git log --pretty=oneline --stat v2.3.9..v2.4.0 | grep tokenizer || true`.
Samir: will do. posting logs in ~20m. thanks. :rocket:
